name: Pizza & Pasta Marktplatz
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizza & Pasta Market Square in Schwaz** – Enjoy authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of **Tirol**! Whether you're craving a crispy **Pizza** or a creamy **Pasta**, this cozy spot in **Schwaz** delivers fresh, delicious dishes with a touch of Alpine charm. Perfect for a quick lunch or a relaxed evening with friends. Just steps away from the historic **Marktplatz**, where you can soak in the lively atmosphere of this picturesque town. Don’t miss out—your taste buds will thank you!
